book.name: Mataayo
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mataayo

content: Yeesu arasakibhwa na Seetaani
Kyaamwe, Yeesu akakaangatwa ne Ekoro Muhoreeru kugya mwiitirigo, okubha asakibhwe na Seetaani.
Akamara eyo eziisiku miroongo ene (40), obhutiku no omwiisi akiisiitya okurya ebhyaakurya. Kubhuteero, akiigwa enzara bhukongʼu.
Niho Seetaani akaaza kumusakya, akamubhuurira, “Aribha awe naawe Omwaana wa Taatabhugya,
swaagya amagina gano giikyoore gabhe emikaate.”
Nawe Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,
Niho Seetaani akamuhira Yeesu mumugye omuhoreeru gwa Yerusaremu, akamwiimeererya kukisoonge kye eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya,
akamubhuurira, “Aribha awe naawe Omwaana wa Taatabhugya, irekera haasi. Otakunagya kunyahaarika, ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,

content.text: ‘Taatabhugya araswaagya bhamaraika bhaaye kwiiguru waazo, okubha bhakuriihe,
amaguru gaazo gataaza kwiitema kwiigina ryoryoosi.’

content: Nawe Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Kweeki ekaamirwe, ‘Otamusakya Omukuru, Taatabhugya waazo.’
Mubhuteero, Seetaani akamuhira Yeesu kukinazo kye ekiguru ekitaambi. Hayo, akamweerekya ebhyaaro bhyoosi bhya mukyaaro hamwe no obhuniibhi bhwamu,
akamubhuurira, “Aribha oraanihigamire no okuniseengera, ndakuha bhyoosi bhino.”
Nawe Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Noorwe hano, Seetaani! Ekaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru,
Niho Seetaani akamutiga Yeesu hayo. Hayohayo, bhamaraika bha Taatabhugya bhakaaza okumuhokeerya Yeesu.
Yeesu arataanga obhuhokya bhwaaye kubhweero
Ambe, eriibhaga rirya Yohana yaari abhohirwe munyuumba ya abhabhohwa. Hano Yeesu akiigwa amangʼana gano, akatanura harya, akagya mukyaaro kya Gariraaya, akahika mumugye gwa Nazareeti.
Niho, Yeesu akasaama okurwa Nazareeti, akagya kwiikara mumugye gwa Kaperinaumu. Omugye guyo gwaari embarika ye Enyaanza ya Gariraaya, orubhaara rwe ekisyooko kya Zaburooni na Nafutaari.
Ekabha ego, okubha rikuunaane eriingʼana rino Taatabhugya yabhugiri kwe enzira yo omurooti Isaya,

content.text: “Mwiitegeerere, abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro bhya Zaburooni na Nafutaari,
ahagiro hano hari munzira yo okweerekera munyaanza,
no omwaambuko gwe Ekitaaro kya Yorodaani.
Gariraaya eyo niho bhakwaanga abhaatu bhe ebhyaaro ebhiindi.
na bhano bhiikeeri mukiirima kyo oruku,

content: Kwe eriibhaga riyo, Yeesu akataanga kurwaazira abhaatu, “Mute ebhibhi bhyeenyu mumwiikyoorere Taatabhugya, kwo okubha obhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro bhubhahikiiri!”
Yeesu arataanga kusora abhaanabheega bhaaye

Hano Yeesu yaari akugeenda embarika we Enyaanza ya Gariraaya, akarora abhategi bhabhiri bhe eziiswe, Simooni wuno yakubhirikirwa Petero na wamwaabhu Andurea. Abhabhiri bhayo bhaari bhararekera eziinzero munyaanza, okubha bhagwaatye eziiswe.
Yeesu akabhabhuurira, “Muuze, munituniirire! Enye ndabhakora mubhe abhategi bha abhaatu.”
Hayohayo, bhakatiga eziinzero zyaabhu, bhakamutuniirira Yeesu.

Hano Yeesu yageendiri embere hasuuhu, akarora abhaatu abhaandi bhabhiri, Yaakobo na wamwaabhu Yohana, abhaana bha Zebedaayo. Abhabhiri bhayo bhaari mubhwaato hamwe na wiise waabhu, bhaari bharazomya eziinzero zyaabhu. Yeesu akabhabhirikira bhamutuniirire.
Eriibhaga riyoriyo, bhakatiga obhwaato na wiise waabhu, bhakamutuniirira Yeesu.
Yeesu areegya abhaatu no okuhorya abharweeri bhaaru
Yeesu yaari ariiruguura mukyaaro kyoosi kya Gariraaya. Yaari arasikira muziinyuumba zye eziisaango
no okweegya abhaatu muyo. Yaari arabharwaazira Amangʼana Amazomu iguru yo obhutemi bhwa mwiisaaro no okuhorya amarweeri gaabhu goosi.

Amangʼana iguru wa Yeesu gaari garanyaragana bhukongʼu tee mukyaaro kyoosi kya Siria. Abhaatu bhakamuhirira abharweeri bhaabhu bhoosi bhano bhana amarweeri ge etuubho maanga maaru. Gati waabhu, bhaari bharimu bhano bhakunyaakibhwa bhukongʼu, bhano bhaatiirirwe na amasaambwa amabhi, bhano bhaari ne eriirimu na bhano ebhiimo bhikuuri. Yeesu akabhahorya bhoosi.
Ambe, abhaatu bhaaru bhukongʼu bhakabha bharamutuniirira okurwa Gariraaya, Dekapoori, Yerusaremu, Yudea na mumwaambuko gwe Ekitaaro kya Yorodaani.

footnotes.text: Seetaani. Rora engʼana yino mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Omwaana wa Taatabhugya. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Eriiseengerero rya Taatabhugya ryaari ni nyuumba esorwa yo okuseengera Taatabhugya mumugye gwa Yerusaremu. Rora eriiseengerero mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Abhategi bha abhaatu, obhugazuro bhwaku ni kubha bharuusye abhaatu okurwa mubhibhi bhyaabhu no okubhakumania hamwe musaango ya abhaatu bha Taatabhugya.

Eziinyuumba zye eziisaango zyaari nyuumba zyo okwiikumanirya Abhayahudi kwiiguru yo okuseengera Taatabhugya, eheene kurusiku rwo okumuunya. Rora enyuumba ye esaango mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
